requirements: PRD F9 (retired; seed cards carried as seed codes for patterns)
note: A starter list of pattern hypotheses a brief can check (codebook §7). Not global cards and not findings: no status, confidence, supporting cases, counterexamples or history here; results live only in each brief's report as neighbourhood patterns. A brief selects hypotheses and may change [design] thresholds before its outcome sort. literature_basis lists reference numbers only; see the .md for what each source reports. Numbers from sources are never effect estimates.
file_name_note: file name kept (candidates-v0.json) because frozen pre-registrations cite it; the v0.2.0 content is at git show archive/global-collection:schemas/mechanisms/candidates-v0.json
changelog: 2026-09-25 — 0.2.0: MC-09 presence test moved to the case-level novelty_claim field of codebook 0.2.0 (§5.1); MC-09 modules [ai_hype] -> []; file codebook_version 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 (no other card's fields changed; codebook 0.2.0 keeps every field they use). Pilot amendment 2, B4. No card has been coded against.

2026-09-26 — 0.3.0 (M11; ADR-047.3, ADR-049.7; PRD F20): reframed as seed pattern hypotheses. Removed per entry: status, confidence, supporting_cases, contradicting_cases, effect_estimate, applicable_strata, saturation_trend, deciding_field_alpha, sensitivity_flags, history. loser_contrast {result, would_support, would_contradict} -> contrast_reading {consistent, against}; strata and §9.3 wording removed; MC-08 forecasting reference removed; MC-09 and MC-11 readings no longer use CM90, AD90, attention_only or coded direction; MC-12 alpha note cites codebook §10.2; unobservable_channels -> unobservable_channels_default. Presence tests, preconditions, assets, sequences and literature bases unchanged. Entry versions -> 0.3.0. No coding or outcome data.

2026-09-26 — 0.4.0 (M21 verifier fix; ADR-070.4, PRD R3.3; codebook 0.4.0, OM v2.1): MC-12 renamed and its presence test moved from the StarScout campaign flag (manipulation_flag=fake_star_campaign_suspected) to the aggregate star anomaly flag (star_anomaly_flagged, anomaly-v0); absent needs every spike checked and the ratio judged (or < 200 stars) [design]; sequence starts at an anomaly-flagged spike; contrast_reading gains proxy_caveat; the md's sensitivity-flag note now names sensitive_to_star_anomaly; literature_basis unchanged, with literature_basis_note. File codebook_version 0.3.0 -> 0.4.0 (no other card uses a field that 0.4.0 renamed). No coding or outcome data.

cards.name: First-party launch post on Hacker News (Show HN / Launch HN)
cards.description: Maker announces the project on HN in a first-party post; an attention burst follows.

preconditions.statement: Something people can try exists at posting
preconditions.test: asset category in {live_demo, install_one_liner} or readme_section with readme_kind=quickstart, first_seen <= launch timestamp
no prep event of kind repo_made_public dated after the launch

order: launch(first_party=yes, venue=HN, span contains 'Show HN' or 'Launch HN')
sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: launch evidence includes a community_post on the HN node with first_party=yes AND all preconditions hold
presence_test.absent: HN coverage for the case window AND no first-party HN item

contrast_reading.consistent: prevalence among the brief's winners > matched losers (unknown-share gap <= 20 pp)
contrast_reading.against: prevalence among matched losers >= winners (H-L7 survivorship pattern)

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: HN front-page exposure
cards.description: An HN story about the repo (any poster) reaches the front page; the exposure produces a short-run star jump.

preconditions.statement: Story links the repo or site
Conversion asset present at story time
preconditions.test: asset category in {live_demo, install_one_liner} or readme_section with readme_kind=quickstart, first_seen <= story timestamp

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: C9=hn_front_page for any burst AND preconditions hold
presence_test.absent: only with front-page observability (own rank polling or Algolia front_page tag) showing no front page
presence_test.else: unknown (coverage_gap for retrospective cases without the tag)

contrast_reading.consistent: H-L2 robust event study vs matched off-front-page HN stories with similar early votes: 90% CI of 48 h star effect excludes 0
contrast_reading.against: CI includes 0, or no winner/loser prevalence difference

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: HN posting in the 12-17 UTC window
cards.description: The first HN story about the repo is posted 12:00-17:00 UTC and gets more early stars than comparable posts at other times.

preconditions.statement: An HN story with hour-precision created_at exists
preconditions.test: HN item with time_precision=hour among trigger candidates or launch evidence

order: launch|hn_post with created_at hour in [12,17) UTC
sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: earliest HN story hour in [12,17) UTC
presence_test.absent: earliest HN story hour outside [12,17) UTC
presence_test.else: unknown (no HN story or no HN coverage)

contrast_reading.consistent: among cases with an HN story, in-window share higher among winners than matched losers
contrast_reading.against: equal shares, or event-study CI includes 0

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: Social-media posts linking the repo
cards.description: Posts on social platforms linking the repo raise stars, with a smaller effect on contributors.

preconditions.statement: At least one social-platform item links the repo in the case window
preconditions.test: item on a social-platform community node with links_repo=yes

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: precondition holds AND item in proximal or distal window of a burst
presence_test.absent: not codable while X is GAP and Bluesky held

contrast_reading.consistent: winner prevalence > matched losers; event-study star effect > 0 and contributor effect smaller
contrast_reading.against: equal prevalence or null star effect; H-L5 falsified if star/contributor effect ratio not > 2

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: Launch week (multi-day announcement campaign)
cards.description: One major feature announced per day over consecutive days, with a planned channel schedule and community amplification.

preconditions.test: >= 3 first-party announcement items in the campaign, each with a distinct quoted feature claim

preconditions.statement: Organisation behind the project (scope assumption: the brief reports the pattern for its org-backed cases)

order: launch|relaunch(campaign=true, sub-items on >= 3 distinct UTC days within 7 d)
sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: launch or relaunch with campaign=true, sub-items on >= 3 distinct UTC days within 7 d, precondition 1 holds; b2b_oss_saas.launch_week must agree when the module is active

contrast_reading.consistent: prevalence among winners > matched losers among the brief's org-backed cases
contrast_reading.against: matched losers ran launch weeks at similar rates (H-L7)

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: Disclosed paid social promotion alongside a launch
cards.description: Disclosed paid promotion on a social platform runs alongside a community launch; together they push the repo onto GitHub's trending page.

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.else: unknown (expected for almost all cases: X GAP, Bluesky held)

contrast_reading.consistent: winner prevalence > matched losers, holding MC-01 constant
contrast_reading.against: equal prevalence; primary use is as a confounder flag for MC-01/MC-02 estimates

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: Active multi-channel first-party promotion
cards.description: The maker actively promotes on several own and community channels around launch rather than relying on one post.

preconditions.statement: Project has an own official channel
preconditions.test: project_artifact blog or docs/site linked from the repo at T

order: first_party=yes items on >= 2 distinct nodes within [T-7 d, T+30 d]
sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: sequence condition holds with supported-level evidence
presence_test.absent: >= 2 observable venues covered and only 1 first-party venue

contrast_reading.consistent: winners use more distinct first-party venues than matched losers (ordinal, across the brief's matched pairs)

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: Early cross-community breadth
cards.description: Within days of the first burst, several distinct communities or publications pick up the repo independently (breadth rather than one broadcast). Currently a spread pattern; no actionable precondition known.

order: published|cited edges (supported) into >= 3 distinct community|publication nodes within [onset-48 h, onset+72 h]
sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

contrast_reading.consistent: breadth more prevalent among winners than matched losers with similar launch-signal magnitude (H-L4)
contrast_reading.against: no difference; without a testable precondition the pattern is descriptive only (codebook §7.1)

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.name: Novelty positioning
cards.description: The project positions itself as novel; this attracts attention but comes with lower long-run participation.

preconditions.test: case-level novelty_claim (codebook §5.1, from 0.2.0) is present, with its quoted span

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

contrast_reading.consistent: novelty claims more prevalent among the brief's winners than matched losers; among winners, those with a claim have fewer returning external contributors at T+90 (comm.returning_external_contributors@90, OM §1.4) than those without (H-L6; within-winner, descriptive, meaningful when the primary dimension is attention)

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

preconditions.test: >= 2 GitHub release records before the burst

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: C9=release for any burst AND precondition holds
presence_test.absent: all bursts have a non-release rank-1 trigger and release records are covered

cards.name: 'Try it now' asset at launch
cards.description: At launch the project offers a zero-friction trial (hosted demo or one-command install), which turns attention into adoption. Basis is a platform rule only.

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: launch exists AND live_demo or install_one_liner asset with first_seen <= launch
presence_test.absent: README and site at launch captured with neither asset

contrast_reading.consistent: winner prevalence > matched losers; among the brief's winners, higher primary-ecosystem downloads at T+90 (OM §1.3) where the asset was present (descriptive)

cards.name: Star inflation suspected from aggregate anomalies (fake-star proxy; anti-pattern; detection and contrast only)
cards.description: Purchased or coordinated fake stars inflate star counts. Ruled out by PRD §4; never recommended (F10, R12.4). Since 0.4.0 detected by pigtail's aggregate anomaly checks (anomaly-v0, OM v2.1 §4), a proxy for the account-level campaigns the literature describes; unvalidated, no precision or recall measured (OM §4.5).

sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)
sequence_timing.note: a case flagged only by ratio_outlier has no dated element: present, but contributes no offset

presence_test.source: star_anomaly_flag (OM v2.1 §4.3; anomaly-v0, schemas/analysis-params/v1.1.0.json block anomaly_check)
presence_test.present: manipulation_flag=star_anomaly_flagged (star_anomaly_flag=true: a spike_no_activity flag whose spike overlaps [T - 30 d, T + k_max), or a ratio_outlier flag within the brief)
presence_test.absent: star_anomaly_flag=false: no such flag, every spike in the window checked against at least one channel (status checked or no_spikes), and the ratio check judged the case or could not only because it had fewer than ratio_min_stars (200) stars [design]
presence_test.else: unknown (unchecked or partly checked spike, missing ratio channel, or no star-history for the window)
presence_test.alpha: C11a units marked derived and excluded from alpha (pipeline-set; codebook §10.2)
presence_test.wording: a suspicion, never proof; no repo called fake in any output

contrast_reading.consistent: H-L8: flagged repos show < 2 months real-star uplift and lower T+365 adoption than matched unflagged repos
contrast_reading.proxy_caveat: contrast is about anomaly-flagged cases, not confirmed campaigns; a null contrast cannot separate no effect from proxy misses or false flags (OM §4.5); report the unknown share per side

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)

cards.literature_basis_note: [17][20][22][26] describe account-level StarScout detection and ground truth, not pigtail's aggregate proxy

cards.name: Vote solicitation on HN (anti-pattern; detection and contrast only)
cards.description: The maker asks people to upvote or comment on an HN launch, which HN guidelines prohibit. Never recommended.

order: item with manipulation_flag=vote_solicitation referencing an HN story
sequence_timing.offsets: filled per brief from its winners that show the pattern (median and range, with n)

presence_test.present: any captured item carries vote_solicitation and references an HN story about the repo
presence_test.absent: never coded (solicitation mostly in unobservable channels)

contrast_reading.consistent: not validly testable by prevalence (absent never observable); reported as the count of present cases per side, and used to flag and exclude cases from MC-01/MC-02 contrasts in sensitivity analyses

unobservable_channels_default.note: a brief recomputes these for its own sources; contrasts use the same channels on both sides (codebook §6.4)
